snippet.title: Blackjack Roulette Steam Page Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Blackjack Roulette, a rogue-like “spin” on two casino classics.

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930450/Blackjack_Roulette/

Get as close to 21 without going over and see how you compare against a roulette wheel of hands to beat. If you keep winning, the wheel keeps spinning! After each round, the wheel gets bigger,  and so does the Buy-In cost. If you can’t afford the Buy-In at the start of a round, it’s Game Over.

Luckily, this casino will gladly sell you insurance. Insurance Policies offer various upgrades and abilities to help, but they’ll cost you. One policy lets you win on ties (for a small fee, of course). Another lets you overcharge your hand over 21 without busting, but will auto-play your next 5 hands automatically. Press your luck and take out the Pit Bosses in Blackjack Roulette.
